f.n: Pulu Keeling National Park (Commonwealth) - Marine Reserve Zone
f.pu: The preservation of the area in its natural condition and the encouragement and regulation of the appropriate use, appreciation and enjoyment of the area by the public. Pulu Keeling National Park is an uninhabited low-lying tropical oceanic coral atoll, mostly covered by sand and fragments of coral…
f.re: Recreational fishing is subject to the following limitations: a) fishing must not be undertaken within 100 metres of the shoreline; b) only fin-fish may be taken; c) only pelagic fish may be taken; d) fishing must only be carried out by trolling or deep-water fishing and not by bottom fishing.
